page.content:
Downtown house where Hamilton premiered before Broadway.

How The Public Theater connects

  • Work: Hamilton (musical) — Hamilton premiered Off-Broadway at the Public Theater.
  • Location: Richard Rodgers Theatre — The Public Theater run came before the Richard Rodgers transfer.

What is The Public Theater?

The Public Theater on Lafayette Street is where Hamilton opened Off-Broadway in February 2015, the downtown workshop stage before the Richard Rodgers transfer.
